description: Check a rendered video (or a job's latest render): codec and color tags, duration, loudness and true peak, silence, black or frozen stretches, captions, credits, and the platform's limits. PASS/WARN/FAIL with timestamps. Do not call a video ready until qa passes. In quality mode (the default) a job's final also needs a critic round: a "review pending" line names the command (showtime review-pack, then a critic sub-agent on its CRITIC.md) until that round has a verdict; lean mode skips it.

background.description: answer at once with a task id and keep working in the background; the status tool with {"task": id} reports progress and the result. Default false: wait for the result (a host with a short tool-call limit gets a task id after about 20 s anyway).

project.description: project folder (default: found from the render report)

video.description: video file, or a job folder/name (default: the current or newest job)

name: qa
title: Verify a finished video
